archivist.jar is a love letter to poets, childhood and art.
It is highly recommended to play with no other story mods.

**_This is a fast-paced psychological exploration mod, with lots of experimental features, like:
fully-aware ai entities, standalone separate apps, 18 dimensions in total, over 70 structures, 20 events, and more than 10 entities._** 

_This mod installs resources, checks game data, displays applications,
errors, warnings, uses powershell, and might have flashing lights.
Archivist.jar will NEVER show ANY personal info on screen._


This mod has over 500 hours of work. Any type of support will always be appreciated, it being word of mouth, sharing or [![donating.](https://ko-fi.com)](https://ko-fi.com)

<small>not allowed to modify under any circumstances<small>
